limits: Training device placement is verified against saved actual post-step probes and record consistency; training was not rerun.

Checkpoints contain actor parameters and optional PPO critic parameters, not complete optimizer state; full-agent finiteness is asserted by the trainer but cannot be independently reconstructed from these checkpoints.
Fresh initialization is a source/record declaration consistent with six distinct weights, not an independent replay of optimization.
Selection is recomputed from validation only and agrees with both saved selection files; file write chronology is not cryptographically attested.
Velocity scenarios combine position +/-0.1m and true velocity +/-0.5m/s perturbations, rather than velocity-only perturbations.
Per-algorithm training budgets and reward coefficients differ; results are not an equal-time or equal-sample comparison.

Initial conditions are exactly equal across all four policies. Reference differences on common active samples are recorded; trajectories are not required to be globally equal after crashes/autoresets.
